name: La Habra Teen Leaders Program
org: City of La Habra Community Services
what_you_do: Get training and hands-on work in city recreation programs with a supervisor. You earn community service hours for school and build skills for future city jobs.
who_can_apply: La Habra teens. In 2026 you had to be 14 to 17 by June 1. How many hours you can give is a big part of who gets picked.
pay_detail: Volunteer program. You earn community service hours.
deadline_text: The 2026 form was due May 8, 2026, teacher notes were due May 18, and the group interview was May 19. 2027 dates are not posted as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: In 2026 you filled out a Google form, got a teacher to send a note, and went to a group interview. Check the page in spring for the 2027 steps.
notes: The page does not say when the program runs. The dates above are all from May, so ask the city for the program dates. You must wear a Teen Leader shirt and follow a contract. Questions: Melissa Rivera, 562-383-4200.
